blocks.text: Mendspool preserves the tools and repeated gestures of repair. Its simple name can outlive a detailed explanation of the material being mended, while the caretaker still reads which kind of injury it helps.
An irregular blue porcelain bobbin with exposed gold staple stitches and a folded coral ribbon.
One-shot use: The spool rotates as its broad coral ribbon unrolls and folds into a large crossed wrap. The game performs the final fade.
24 silver. Injury severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +12. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
